zero_means: no retry: one read, as before BH-9555.3
note: BH-10453 (BH-9555.3). The time budget of cnr_retry for one read: a could-not-read answer (401, 403, 429, 5xx, no answer) is read again after 2, 4 and 8 s while elapsed + step fits the budget. A decision (200, 404, 422) is never retried. An empty budget argument reads this knob: env, else the row lib.could-not-read.cnr_retry_budget_s through lib_env_apply (once a shell), else 20. A value that is not a whole number reads 20; above 120 reads 120.
